name: Nantipa Beach & Resort
insider_take: This boutique beachfront sanctuary sits on one of Costa Rica's most pristine stretches of Pacific coastline, where world-class surf breaks meet untouched tropical wilderness.
whats_special: Nantipa is perfectly positioned on Playa Santa Teresa, consistently ranked among the world's top surf destinations. The resort features Costa Rica's first beach club concept and offers direct access to the famous Playa Carmen break. Santa Teresa is part of the Nicoya Peninsula Blue Zone, where residents enjoy exceptional longevity thanks to the pure lifestyle and pristine environment.
pro_tip: Visit during the dry season (December-April) for the most consistent surf conditions, but book the rainy season (May-November) for lush jungle scenery and fewer crowds.
dont_miss: Catch sunrise at nearby Cabo Blanco Nature Reserve, Costa Rica's first protected area. Take a horseback ride to the hidden Montezuma Waterfalls, or join a night turtle nesting tour at Playa Grande during peak season (October-March).
pros: Prime beachfront location on pristine Santa Teresa Beach
Luxury eco-conscious design with sustainable practices
World-class surfing destination with direct beach access
Exceptional spa services and wellness facilities
cons: Remote location requires longer travel time
Limited dining options in immediate vicinity
